executive_assessment.text: The announcement identifies low-lying coastal settlement as a major source of climate exposure in Samoa.
A West Coast Road business account recalls cyclone and wave damage to the road serving coastal businesses.
Sālelologa on Savai'i is targeted for resilient infrastructure and urban planning to manage settlement growth and exposure.

geographic_notes.text: Sālelologa; Savai'i: Sālelologa on Savai'i is targeted for resilient infrastructure and urban planning to manage settlement growth and exposure.
Faleolo International Airport: Flooding in 2018 and 2020 disrupted Faleolo International Airport; coastal transport assets face storm-surge, flood and rising-sea risk.
West Coast Road; Upolu: A West Coast Road business account recalls cyclone and wave damage to the road serving coastal businesses.
West Coast Road: The feature reports a completed road upgrade and improved business confidence; testimony does not establish the size or durability of resilience gains.
